mapper.select: select date_format(create_date, '%Y-%m') as loginMonth, count(distinct user_id) as userCnt from statistic.request_info ri group by date_format(create_date, '%Y-%m') order by loginMonth;
select create_date as loginDate, count(distinct user_id) as userCnt from statistic.request_info ri group by create_date order by create_date;
select round(count(*) / count(distinct create_date), 2) as avgCnt from statistic.request_info;

select u.hr_organ as dep, date_format(r.create_date, '%Y-%m') as loginMonth, count(*) as totCnt from request_info r join statistic.user u on r.user_id = u.user_id group by u.hr_organ, date_format(r.create_date, '%Y-%m') order by u.hr_organ, loginMonth
